exercises.hint: Concatenate the pieces in document order: doctype, <html>, <head> with <title>, then <body>.
exercises.task: Write buildPage(title, bodyText): return a full minimal HTML document as a string.

exercises.hint: Push opening tag names onto a stack; a closing tag must match the last one pushed. Skip self-closing tags like .
exercises.task: Write isBalanced(html): return true only if tags nest and close correctly.

exercises.hint: Check html.includes("<!DOCTYPE html>"), ("<head>") and ("<body>"); collect what's missing.
exercises.task: Write validateDoc(html): report whether the document skeleton is complete.
